name: choice-poll
title: Choice Poll
description: A one-question poll: a heading and description over four radio rows. Choosing one locks the vote and turns every row into a bar with its share, a percentage and the total count.
use: You want a one-question vote on the page and to show the split once the visitor answers.
avoid: There is no backend: votes and hasVoted must be wired up yourself or the poll shows nothing real.
a11y: Arrow keys, Home and End move between options, but the listbox has no accessible name and percentage changes are not announced. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark card holds a bold question, a small muted sentence, and four stacked rounded rows with thin outlines. Each row starts with a circular marker and a label; after voting a soft fill grows from the left of each row and a percentage sits at the right.
behaves: Hovering lights a row's border and background. Clicking one fills its marker with a tick, disables the rows, and reveals results: each bar grows to its share, percentages count up, and a footer shows the total votes and a "You voted" mark.
customise: Root takes value, multiple, disabled, showResults, votes and hasVoted; the heading, description and option rows are passed as child components. Styling is class-based.
weight: light: Four rows of DOM with short CSS transitions and a one-shot frame counter per bar.
